cohort: The study was performed on 150 healthy term newborns (84 males, 66 females) with gestational age >38 weeks, all delivered by caesarian section.
finding: Cord serum albumin (CSA) levels <=2.8 g/dl are a critical risk factor for developing neonatal hyperbilirubinemia, while CSA levels >=3.4 g/dl indicate a low risk for NH, suggesting suitability for early discharge.
